headlines.name: Math115.AllSmallRepairFiber.reduced_repairTable_fiber_card
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (hrU : ∀ (i : I), r i < U) (hcU : ∀ (j : J), c j < U) (A : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  Fintype.card { z // Math115.AllSmallRepairFiber.reducedRepairTable r c U L hrU hcU z = A } =
    1 + (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card J - 1) * Fintype.card (Math115.AllSmallRepairFiber.SupportedCell ↑A)

headlines.name: Math115.RepairAcceptancePhysical.physical_finiteBit_retry_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J]
  [inst_4 : Nonempty I] [inst_5 : Nonempty J] (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (hrU : ∀ (i : I), r i < U)
  (hcU : ∀ (j : J), c j < U),
  (∀ (i : I), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (j : J), 0 < c j) →
      ∀ (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)
        (p : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L)) (δ : ℚ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation p OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤ δ →
          ∀ (k R : ℕ),
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.retryLaw
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw p fun x =>
                    Math115.RepairAcceptanceCoin.finiteBitLaw
                      (Math115.AllSmallRepairFiber.reducedRepairTable r c U L hrU hcU x) k
                      Math115.RepairAcceptancePhysical.acceptanceScale
                      (Math115.RepairAcceptancePhysical.repairWeight
                        (Math115.AllSmallRepairFiber.reducedRepairTable r c U L hrU hcU x)))
                  id fallback R)
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
              (1 -
                    ↑Math115.RepairAcceptancePhysical.acceptanceScale /
                      ↑(Math115.RepairAcceptancePhysical.fibreAllowance r)) ^
                  R +
                ↑R * (δ + 1 / 2 ^ k)

headlines.name: Math115.FiniteStarTrace.poincare_transfer
headlines.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_2} {D : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype D] (R : D → B) (W : D → D → ℝ)
  (Efull : (B ⊕ D → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
  (∀ (F : B ⊕ D → ℝ), Efull F = Math115.FiniteStarTrace.decomposedEnergy R W F) →
    (∀ (F : B ⊕ D → ℝ), OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance (fun x => 1) F ≤ C * Efull F) →
      ∀ (g : D → ℝ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance (fun x => 1) g ≤
          C * Math115.FiniteStarTrace.traceEnergy R W g
